sloka: शस्त्रवर्णः सुपरुषो मन्दरश्मिर्दिवाकरः ।अदृश्यत कबन्धाङ्कः संसक्तो धूमकेतुना ।। ६.१०३.३२ ।।
transliteration: śastravarṇaḥ suparuṣo mandaraśmirdivākaraḥ ।adṛśyata kabandhāṅkaḥ saṁsakto dhūmaketunā ।। 6.103.32 ।।

translations.english: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.
translations.hindi: सबभूतक्षयकारी कालान्तक यमराज की तरह तेजस्वी रावण राक्षसों की सेना साथ लिये संथा हाथ में रोदा चढा चढाया ५ तैयार ) धनुष लिए हुए निकला.
